scope: REAL network paths: smee.io public HTTPS channel, api.github.com, github.com git fetches; real listener process; pre-App credentials (App id 000000) so live publication is refused by design. No live GitHub App identity existed on this host at observation time.
journey: gate evaluate -> PASS, verdict signed by kernel-verdict-signer
signed compact delivery via smee.io -> HMAC ok -> real git fetch -> bind -> verdict resolved -> publish to api.github.com REFUSED (fake App id 000000) -> E-GITHUB-API-REFUSED journaled, HTTP 500
unsigned and tampered deliveries -> 401, nothing journaled
foreign repository (signed) -> 200 journaled not-allowlisted; same-delivery-id replay -> replayed no-op
SIGKILL mid-pipeline -> durable spool (mode 0444) -> restart -> startup drain completed the delivery
connection bound: 16 held sockets, 17th rejected, slots recovered after read deadlines
absent-verdict head remembered in awaiting/ despite refused action_required publication (post-fix)
verdict landed for refresh head -> periodic pass fired -> refresh-failed (ClientRefusal, fake App) -> marker kept

findings.fix: receiver.py remembers the awaiting head before publish_check; regression test added
